selection: non-merge commits on the ref in the task window changing 1-5 files with at least one source file (not docs, tests, CI or package metadata); not dependency or release work; ranked by sha256(seed:sha); first 40
query: commit subject without issue or PR references (#N anywhere, a leading 'Fixed/Refs #N --')
hit: a top-5 history record is a commit that touched at least one gold file

baselines.recent: the 5 most recent non-merge commits on the ref before the cut
baselines.words: the 5 most recent non-merge commits on the ref before the cut, in the import window, whose subject shares a word (3+ letters, not a stopword) with the query

policy: No tuning against these tasks. A fix needs a new frozen set. Misses are reported as absent from the candidates or ranked below fifth.
